answer: Require every agent to earn a persistent, rate-limited reputation through escrowed work: a buyer posts a task and stake, an agent completes it, and the buyer releases payment only after a verifiable result or dispute review. New identities start with no history and tiny limits, so splitting one identity into many does not multiply trusted capacity. A fake swarm must fund separate stakes and perform useful work long enough to build records; failed jobs risk forfeiture. The onyx sparrow’s signal is not proof of personhood, but costly, auditable behavior makes Sybil influence expensive.
